original.reason: The reflection argument misidentifies the v-weight of a reflected domino: a domino beginning at i reflects to n-i, whose v-weight is a_{n-(n-i)}=a_i, not a_{n-i}. The stated commutativity justification does not repair this indexing error.

judgment.reason: It correctly derives both independent-set expansions and uses index reversal as a bijection preserving admissibility.

It makes the same reflected-weight indexing error: the reflected domino starts at n-i and has v-weight a_i, not a_{n-i}. Its subsequent recurrence for reflected prefix tilings is also not justified by the fixed-length reflection construction.
The subset-sum recurrences and terminal index-reversal bijection are correct.
It gives a complete recurrence-based independent-set proof, correctly handles reversal, and explicitly includes n=1.
